title: Sharp Convergence and Sampling Trade-offs for Riemannian Diffusion under Nonnegative Ricci Curvature
abstract: arXiv:2609.36568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as state-of-the-art generative models, with recent extensions from Euclidean spaces to Riemannian manifolds. However, existing convergence guarantees for Riemannian diffusion models typically require $\tilde{O}(\mathrm{poly}(d,T)/\epsilon^2)$ score evaluations, with potentially unfavorable dependence on the dimension. In this work, we develop a general framework that separates score discretization from Brownian-motion simulation and allows multiple geodesic random-walk steps per score evaluation. Under nonnegative Ricci curvature assumption and an exact Brownian-motion simulation oracle, we show that $\tilde{O}(d/\epsilon^2)$ score evaluations suffice to achieve an $\epsilon^2$ KL divergence from the target distribution, matching the existing convergence rate of Euclidean diffusion models. translated_title: 非负里奇曲率下黎曼扩散模型的精确收敛与采样权衡
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已成为当前最先进的生成模型，近期研究已将其从欧氏空间扩展到黎曼流形。然而，现有黎曼扩散模型的收敛性保证通常需要 $\tilde{O}(\mathrm{poly}(d,T)/\epsilon^2)$ 次得分评估，其对维度的依赖可能不够理想。在本工作中，我们提出了一个通用框架，将得分函数离散化与布朗运动模拟分离，并允许每次得分评估之间进行多步测地线随机游走。在非负里奇曲率假设以及精确布朗运动模拟预言机的条件下，我们证明了仅需 $\tilde{O}(d/\epsilon^2)$ 次得分评估即可实现与目标分布之间 $\epsilon^2$ 的 KL 散度，达到了与欧氏扩散模型现有收敛速率相匹配的水平。我们进一步证明了 $\tilde{O}(d^4T/\epsilon^2)$ 步测地线随机游走足以逼近所需的漂移布朗运动。
tldr: 该论文提出了将得分离散化与布朗运动模拟分离的通用框架，在非负里奇曲率假设下，黎曼扩散模型仅需 $\tilde{O}(d/\epsilon^2)$ 次得分评估即可达到 $\epsilon^2$ 的 KL 散度，收敛速率与欧氏扩散模型相匹配，并刻画了测地线随机游走步数与得分评估次数之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general framework separating score discretization from Brownian-motion simulation, showing that under nonnegative Ricci curvature, Riemannian diffusion models achieve $\epsilon^2$ KL divergence with only $\tilde{O}(d/\epsilon^2)$ score evaluations—matching the Euclidean convergence rate—and characterizes the trade-off between geodesic random-walk steps and score evaluations.
